API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APICertificate ManagementGets the certificate details for the specified ID. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
Gets the certificate details for the specified ID. This API will be deprecated in a future release.
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v1/admin/customers/:customerId/clientlessCertificate/:certificateId
DEPRECATED

This endpoint has been deprecated and may be replaced or removed in future versions of the API.

Gets the certificate details for the specified ID. This API will be deprecated in a future release.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
customerId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the ZPA tenant.

certificateId
int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of the certificate.

QUERY PARAMETERS
microtenantId
int64

The unique identifier of the microtenant of ZPA tenant. For Default microtenant 0 should be passed and for Customer data microtenant should be null.

Responses
​
200
400
401
403
404
405
409
415

503

OK
